verdict.rationale: Cactus lists official bindings for Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native, Python and Rust (gh-4). The Needle README documents a Python SDK with a decorator-based tool API and generation pinning (docs-13, docs-22). The hosted platform can be driven from Python or the CLI with an API key (docs-9), and a community user found the API very simple to adopt in React Native (comm-16), though another flagged that models download inline at runtime with no separate cache API (comm-18). Missing for 10: per-language SDK reference documentation in the evidence, hands-on corroboration beyond React Native, and a dedicated download/cache API in the SDKs.
